top_signals.title: Stolen shoes on eBay lead police to $1 million in missing BNSF train cargo
top_signals.summary:
An eBay listing for stolen shoes exposed a $1 million cargo recovery in Los Angeles. Investigators arrested the business owner, but questions remain about where the merchandise originated.

The post Stolen shoes on eBay lead police to $1 million in missing BNSF train cargo appeared first on FreightWaves.
